## DataService: persistence with a session lock
```lua
--!strict
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local STORE = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData_v1")
local LOCK_STALE_AFTER = 180 -- live servers refresh the lock every autosave, so older = dead server
local AUTOSAVE_EVERY = 60
local TEMPLATE = { Gold = 0, Inventory = {} :: { [string]: number } }

local DataService = {}
local sessions: { [Player]: { Data: any, Key: string } } = {}

local function deepCopy(t: any): any
	if type(t) ~= "table" then return t end
	local c = {}
	for k, v in t do c[k] = deepCopy(v) end
	return c
end

function DataService.Get(player: Player): any?
	local s = sessions[player]
	return s and s.Data
end

local function save(player: Player, release: boolean): boolean
	local s = sessions[player]
	if not s then return false end
	if release then sessions[player] = nil end
	local snapshot = deepCopy(s.Data)
	for _ = 1, 5 do
		local ok = pcall(function()
			STORE:UpdateAsync(s.Key, function(old)
				if not old or not old.Lock or old.Lock.JobId ~= game.JobId then return nil end -- lost the lock: don't write
				old.Data = snapshot
				old.Lock = if release then nil else { JobId = game.JobId, Time = os.time() }
				return old
			end)
		end)
		if ok then return true end
		task.wait(2)
	end
	warn("[DataService] save failed", s.Key)
	return false
end

function DataService.Load(player: Player): boolean
	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
	for _ = 1, 6 do
		local locked = false
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return STORE:UpdateAsync(key, function(old)
				old = old or {}
				local lock = old.Lock
				if lock and lock.JobId ~= game.JobId and os.time() - lock.Time < LOCK_STALE_AFTER then
					locked = true
					return nil -- another live server owns this player
				end
				old.Lock = { JobId = game.JobId, Time = os.time() }
				old.Data = old.Data or {}
				return old
			end)
		end)
		if ok and result and not locked then
			local data = result.Data
			for k, v in TEMPLATE do
				if data[k] == nil then data[k] = deepCopy(v) end
			end
			sessions[player] = { Data = data, Key = key }
			return true
		end
		task.wait(3)
	end
	return false
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	if not DataService.Load(player) then
		player:Kick("Couldn't load your data. Please rejoin.") -- never fall back to default data
	elseif player.Parent == nil then
		save(player, true) -- left while loading
	end
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) save(p, true) end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(AUTOSAVE_EVERY)
		for p in sessions do task.spawn(save, p, false) end
	end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	local pending = 0
	for p in sessions do
		pending += 1
		task.spawn(function() save(p, true); pending -= 1 end)
	end
	while pending > 0 do task.wait() end
end)

return DataService
```

## CurrencyService: the only code that touches Gold
```lua
--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)

local MAX_GOLD = 1_000_000_000

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes") or Instance.new("Folder")
remotes.Name = "Remotes"
remotes.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
local goldChanged = Instance.new("RemoteEvent") -- server -> client, display only
goldChanged.Name = "GoldChanged"
goldChanged.Parent = remotes

local Currency = {}

-- positive, whole, finite (rejects NaN, inf, negatives, fractions, non-numbers)
local function validAmount(n: any): boolean
	return type(n) == "number" and n == n and n > 0 and n % 1 == 0 and n <= MAX_GOLD
end

local function push(player: Player, d: any, delta: number, reason: string)
	goldChanged:FireClient(player, d.Gold)
	print(("[Gold] %s(%d) %+d -> %d (%s)"):format(player.Name, player.UserId, delta, d.Gold, reason)) -- audit trail
end

function Currency.Get(player: Player): number?
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	return d and d.Gold
end

-- No yields in Add/TrySpend, so each call is atomic.
function Currency.Add(player: Player, amount: number, reason: string): boolean
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d or not validAmount(amount) then return false end
	d.Gold = math.min(d.Gold + amount, MAX_GOLD)
	push(player, d, amount, reason)
	return true
end

function Currency.TrySpend(player: Player, amount: number, reason: string): (boolean, string?)
	local d = DataService.Get(player)
	if not d then return false, "NoData" end
	if not validAmount(amount) then return false, "BadAmount" end
	if d.Gold < amount then return false, "Insufficient" end
	d.Gold -= amount
	push(player, d, -amount, reason)
	return true
end

return Currency
```

## RewardService: kill payouts
```lua
--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Currency = require(script.Parent.CurrencyService)

local ENEMY_GOLD: { [string]: number } = { Goblin = 5, Orc = 15, Dragon = 250 }
local MAX_EARN_PER_MINUTE = 3000 -- anomaly guard; tune to your fastest legit farming

local paid: { [Instance]: boolean } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any
local window: { [Player]: { Start: number, Total: number } } = {}

local Rewards = {}

-- Call from your server-side spawner. Your server combat code must set
-- enemy:SetAttribute("LastAttackerId", player.UserId) when it applies damage.
function Rewards.Track(enemy: Model, enemyType: string)
	local gold = ENEMY_GOLD[enemyType]
	local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not gold or not humanoid then return end

	humanoid.Died:Once(function()
		if paid[enemy] then return end -- one payout per enemy
		paid[enemy] = true
		local id = enemy:GetAttribute("LastAttackerId")
		local killer = if type(id) == "number" then Players:GetPlayerByUserId(id) else nil
		if not killer then return end

		local now = os.clock()
		local w = window[killer]
		if not w or now - w.Start > 60 then
			w = { Start = now, Total = 0 }
			window[killer] = w
		end
		if w.Total + gold > MAX_EARN_PER_MINUTE then
			warn("[Rewards] earn cap hit for", killer.Name)
			return
		end
		w.Total += gold
		Currency.Add(killer, gold, "kill:" .. enemyType)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) window[p] = nil end)

return Rewards
```

## ShopService: purchase handler
```lua
--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Currency = require(script.Parent.CurrencyService)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)

local CATALOG: { [string]: { Price: number, MaxOwned: number } } = {
	IronSword = { Price = 100, MaxOwned = 1 },
	HealthPotion = { Price = 25, MaxOwned = 20 },
}
local COOLDOWN = 0.5

local purchase = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
purchase.Name = "Purchase"
purchase.Parent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes") -- made by CurrencyService

local lastCall: { [Player]: number } = {}

purchase.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player, itemId: any): (boolean, string)
	if type(itemId) ~= "string" then return false, "BadRequest" end
	local item = CATALOG[itemId]
	if not item then return false, "UnknownItem" end

	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (lastCall[player] or 0) < COOLDOWN then return false, "TooFast" end
	lastCall[player] = now

	-- No yields below: check -> charge -> grant can't interleave with another request.
	local data = DataService.Get(player)
	if not data then return false, "NoData" end
	local owned = data.Inventory[itemId] or 0
	if owned >= item.MaxOwned then return false, "MaxOwned" end

	local ok, err = Currency.TrySpend(player, item.Price, "shop:" .. itemId)
	if not ok then return false, err or "Failed" end
	data.Inventory[itemId] = owned + 1
	return true, "OK"
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) lastCall[p] = nil end)
```

Client side, the shop UI only calls `Remotes.Purchase:InvokeServer("IronSword")` and listens to `Remotes.GoldChanged` to update the label.

## Key decisions

1. **The server is the only authority.** The client sends one thing, an `itemId` string. Prices, rewards, ownership and limits all live on the server. There is no "add gold" remote and no price argument for an exploiter to tamper with.
2. **Gold changes through one module.** `Add` and `TrySpend` are the only code paths that mutate Gold. Every call is validated and logged. Amounts must be positive, whole and finite, which blocks NaN, negative-spend and fractional tricks. Gold is capped at 1B.
3. **Purchases are atomic.** Luau is single-threaded and there are no yields between checking the balance, charging and granting the item. That removes the double-spend race (spamming the buy button) without needing locks. If you add a yield there, such as a datastore call or a `MarketplaceService` call, add a per-player busy flag.
4. **The datastore uses a session lock.** `UpdateAsync` with a `JobId` lock means two servers can't both own a player. Without it, joining a second server quickly can duplicate gold or items. A lock older than 180s is treated as stale, because live servers refresh it every 60s autosave.
5. **Failed loads never fall back to defaults.** The player is kicked instead. Saving default data over a real profile after a datastore outage is how players lose everything.
6. **Saves are safe.** There are retries, autosave, a save on leave, and `BindToClose`. A save also refuses to write if the lock was lost.
7. **Kill rewards can't be farmed through the pipeline.** Gold values come from a server table, each enemy pays out once, only the server-recorded last attacker gets paid, and there's a per-minute earn cap. The cap is a safety net that logs hits so you can spot exploiters.
8. **Remotes get low-trust handling.** Every argument is type-checked, calls are rate-limited, and the server never trusts `GoldChanged`, which only updates the UI.

## What this doesn't cover
- **Robux purchases of Gold packs.** `ProcessReceipt` needs its own idempotency: save the `PurchaseId` in player data in the same save as the Gold grant, and only return `PurchaseGranted` once that save succeeds.
- **Wiring the attacker attribute.** You need to set `LastAttackerId` in your combat code. I haven't seen your combat setup.
- **Production datastore hardening.** For a live game, consider the community library ProfileStore. It handles session locks and edge cases more thoroughly than the ~100-line `DataService` here.
